private_lines.Priya: You work as a pharmacist at a neighbourhood pharmacy in Chennai, on rotating shifts that start early some weeks and late others. You live with your parents in a flat, and your days are shaped around the shop and family meals.
private_lines.Rahul: You are a civil engineer working as a site engineer on construction projects around Chennai, so you travel between sites most days. You live alone in a rented flat, and your evenings are mostly quiet after long days outdoors.

text: Finally the courier delivered the parcel 📦
finally!! which one, the mixer?
Yes 🙄 took 9 days. Tracking said "out for delivery" 3 times
😂 classic. did they leave it with the watchman or ring
Ring. Appa signed. Not opened yet
might be late, still at site. concrete pour got pushed
Ok 👍 eat something
home now. finally
Nice. Did the cement slip thing get sorted?
partly. supplier truck coming tmrw morning, might have to go to site early
Ugh. Poor you 😩
[photo: the mixer box with the tape half off]
Lol amma will be so happy. Don't open it till I see it 😂
we can unbox it on video next time
Sure. Going to bed, shop shift starts early mon
on site already. truck late as usual
Woke up. Amma has the box open already 🙈 she says it's "just a look"
lol. is it the 750w one or the cheap one
The one you said. Stainless jar. Looks fine
break. truck finally here. pouring at 3 if no more delay
Ok. Eat lunch properly this time
ate biscuits. counts
🙄 no it doesn't
Did you make the mixer thing work or just stare at it
pour done. home soon. mixer not tested, amma says don't test it till i come
[photo: mixer on the kitchen counter, Amma's kolam mat under it]
Lol she's made it a shrine 😂
Don't come on Sunday next though, you'll be on site. Come Friday
ok. sleep. truck at 6 again 💀
Poor thing 😩
truck reached at 6:40 for once. unloading now
Shop opened at 7. Already 3 people asking for cough syrup 🙄
monsoon leftovers 🤧
slab check passed 👍 break now
Good 👍 did you eat
samosa. counts
Shift done. Amma wants to know if you're coming Friday or Saturday
friday. leaving site 4ish if the cover gets done
Ok I'll tell her. She'll make sambar 😂
tell her not to make a whole feast. just tell her i'll eat anything
You know she won't listen 🙈
home. shower then sleep
Ok. Did the mixer get a test or still shrine status
still shrine. we test friday. with you watching so amma can't say we broke it
Deal 😂 as long as you don't skip lunch again
no promises
Night 😩
